name: ExxonMobil
notes: Revenue = 'Total revenues and other income' (2000-2002: 'Total revenue'), includes sales-based (excise) taxes in earlier years as reported. ExxonMobil reports no operating income line, so operatingIncome is derived for every year (quality estimated) as 'Income before income taxes' plus 'Interest expense' (a separate line in costs; very small in 2013 and other years because interest is mostly capitalized). Equity-affiliate income and other income (which holds interest income and asset-sale gains) stay in, as the face of the statement does not separate them. 2009+ from SEC XBRL company facts (us-gaap Revenues, IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxes..., InterestExpense), values as last reported in later 10-Ks (may reflect restatements). FY ends Dec 31.
